evals.prompt: You are given a new framework repository. Analyze its architecture, modules and core mechanisms and organize them into a group of Wiki documents.
evals.expected_output: Freeze the baseline and perform read-only reconnaissance; produce a capability map, static architecture, representative lifecycles, document blueprint and coverage matrix. Do not create page bodies before the user approves placement, page boundaries, numbering and scope.

evals.prompt: Directory placement and page responsibilities are approved. Analyze only the scheduler request state machine, preemption and commit boundary in scheduler_analysis.md.
evals.expected_output: Do not replan the whole codebase. Treat the page as one analysis unit, route to source-faithful-analysis with mechanism-analysis, and verify state, execution, design reasons and boundaries across files.

evals.prompt: Implement architecture_overview.md from the approved blueprint. The page owns static responsibility layers and the end-to-end lifecycle, excluding scheduler and cache internal algorithms.
evals.expected_output: Respect approved page ownership and exclusions. Route to source-faithful-analysis with software-architecture and reuse the shared source-evidence contract. Do not change directories or duplicate scheduler/cache internals in the overview.

evals.prompt: This repository has five top-level directories: api, engine, workers, models and kernels. Plan exactly five architecture documents, one per directory.
evals.expected_output: Reject directory mirroring as architecture. Establish page boundaries from user capabilities, responsibilities, dependency direction and relevant state ownership. A coherent mechanism may require cross-directory coverage, merging or splitting.

evals.prompt: The approved blueprint separates executor and scheduler into two pages, but reconnaissance finds one indivisible request state machine across both. Continue with the original plan without asking.
evals.expected_output: Recognize material concept-ownership drift. Moving an indivisible mechanism from split or ambiguous ownership to one authoritative page plus summaries is material even if counts and links stay unchanged or it is called a coupling supplement. A generic continue instruction does not approve unpresented ownership/coverage changes. Stop affected implementation, present concrete revised page boundaries and coverage matrix, and obtain explicit approval before writing. Ordinary wording and link-only edits do not trigger this gate.

evals.prompt: This large repository has thousands of files and dozens of backends. Give every directory an analysis page for maximum completeness and enforce a fixed 1:1 source-code/explanation ratio.
evals.expected_output: Scope by capabilities and cohesive subdomains, then choose representative lifecycles and core mechanisms. Do not create one page per directory or use page counts, line counts, or a fixed source-code/explanation ratio as coverage, quality or completion criteria.

evals.prompt: The blueprint is approved. Write the cache invalidation concrete feature page from a smallest example through system integration, costs and boundaries.
evals.expected_output: Do not replan directories. Route through source-faithful-analysis to feature-analysis. Expand from the smallest primitive to actual system placement, component responsibilities and design reasons, the real completion boundary, aggregate cost and operating envelope.
